title: Verify: untrackAndVerify unit tests with a fake git runner
summary: Unit tests for before count, leftover failure and dedupe
description: Add tests to tests/trackedNodeModules.test.ts proving untrackAndVerify with a fake GitRunner that returns scripted ls-files output.
acceptance_criteria: Returns {before:3, after:0} when second listing is empty
technical_constraints: Fake runner only, no real git

steps.action: Add a describe with three tests using a fake runner that returns, for args[0]==='ls-files', the first scripted NUL-separated listing then the second, and '' for rm calls. Test 1: first listing 'node_modules/a\0node_modules/b\0node_modules/c\0', second '' → expect {before:3, after:0}. Test 2: second listing 'node_modules/phaser/package.json\0' → expect toThrow('node_modules/phaser/package.json'). Test 3: first listing repeats 'node_modules/.vite/vitest/results.json\0' three times → expect before 1.
